title: README quickstart is broken independent of the Story path: lore new spec --story does not exist; lore init defaults the tracker to Quest while step 3 couples Backlog tasks
description: Found running README.md:187-226 verbatim against the LCLI-570 fix binary (dist/lore built from fix/LCLI-570-story-output-path) and against published 0.9.0, 2026-09-23. On BOTH binaries: (1) 'lore new spec "Order archival" --story stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders' exits 2, 'unknown option "--story"'. No --story option exists in src/commands/new.ts at v0.7.0, v0.8.0, v0.9.0 or dev (positive control: 'summary' matches 9 times at every tag). (2) 'lore link stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders task-42 task-57' on the fix binary exits 6, 'Quest workspace is not initialized': lore init writes [tracker] backend = "quest", while the README's step 3 says it couples Backlog.md tasks, and task-42/task-57 are illustrative ids that exist in no fresh repo. ODOC-262 says every command after the first fails on 0.9.0 for README readers. On 0.9.0, steps 3 and 5 fail for these reasons, and only link/context/tasks fail for the stories/ path. The README ships in the npm tarball, so fixing it changes shipped content.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every command in README.md quickstart runs to exit 0 in a fresh git repo against a built binary, driven from the README text itself rather than a retyped copy
The quickstart states which tracker it assumes and creates or names tasks that exist

implementationNotes: Reviewer pass (opum-workflow reviewer) on 4abac24c: 1 High, 2 Medium, 2 Low, 1 nit, 1 out of scope. Fixed: (High) on a TTY the lore init wizard refuses an uninitialized Quest workspace (reproduced: 'lore init --tracker quest' exits 6 before quest init and 0 after), so quest init now precedes lore init; (Medium) the install section now names Quest; (Low) the command floor is 14, && / || are refused, and actor env vars are unset; (nit) ci-workflow.test.ts asserts the step. Negative controls, all red: --story exit 2, missing marker exit 2, '|| true' exit 2, removed export with a leaked caller actor exit 6. OPEN, not this task's to decide: compile smoke (ubuntu) is not a required context on dev, so this gate is advisory until someone adds it to the require-ci-on-dev ruleset (append-only, after it is green on dev). That goes to the user. Out of scope, filed separately: the README check --json example.
finalSummary: README quickstart rewritten for Quest (git init, quest init, actor export, task-1/task-2, then lore init/new/link/sync/check/query/context; --story removed; install section names Quest). scripts/readme-quickstart.sh runs the commands between the README markers verbatim; compile smoke (ubuntu) runs it against the freshly built binary. Proven in PR #254 CI run 36086637668: 'readme-quickstart: all 14 commands exited 0' on ubuntu with lore 0.9.2 source build + quest 0.10.0. Four local negative controls red (--story exit 2, missing marker exit 2, || exit 2, leaked actor exit 6). Open: compile smoke is not a required context on dev (user decision).
